facts.business: Gulf Oil Lubricants India Limited manufactures and sells lubricants and AdBlue, with a network of Gulf Bike and Car Stops, OEM customers, and B2B/B2C touchpoints across India and 25+ export countries.

capacity_or_capex.timeline: Repayable in 120 monthly installments with 24 months moratorium, until September 2035

guidance_or_targets.statement: Core lubricants sales volume growth target for FY 2025-26
